text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Another impressive victory for Agnes
Digital! Just
how many G1s does she
plan to take?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We run at every racecourse we can, and
Agnes
Digital keeps on winning and
winning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her acclaim resounds throughout the
city.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh man, we are killin' it. Who'd have
thunk I'd win
this much?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I can't even walk around the city without
people
recognizing me and calling me
that shhhweet
name...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Oh! It's Agnes Digital!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Or should I say... the Ruler of the Mile!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ruler of the Mile? What happened
to
All-Rounder?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Look! It's the Ruler of the Mile! The
Ruler of the
Mile is here!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's going on?! Have I entered
some kinda
parallel universe?! I'm
supposed to be the
All-Rounder...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curious, we head to the library to check
her race
records.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting. So, I looked over
the
records to check on that question
you had...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Based on your achievements, it appears
"Ruler of
the Mile" is an appropriate
title.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A junior-year G1 mile, the Oka Sho, the
NHK
Mile Cup, the Mile Championship,
the February
Stakes, the Victoria Mile,
and the Yasuda Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You won all of them. It's an
unprecedented
record. Honestly, they
should be calling you
"Hero of the Mile."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, talk to me more, Ms. Librarian...
And I
love... your glasses...hehe...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Uh? U-ummm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stop the conversation from going off
the rails. It
seems we unknowingly
conquered all the
renowned mile races.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Is it me? Am I crazy???

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I don't know! Everyone was calling me
the
All-Rounder, but now...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's not that I don't like people
calling me
the Ruler of the Mile. It's
just... it might give
people the wrong
impression, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Digitan's willing to simp in any distance!
Simping
and I go together like Adam
and Eve, tops and
bottoms, bad movies
and scream queens!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I can't specialize in miles and be an all-rounder, so I'll have to pick one and stick to it... But which one?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Someone shows up as Agnes Digital
ponders her
dilemma...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, if it isn't the Ruler of the Mile!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Look, Flower! It's Digital! She's really been on fire lately...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Agnes Digital. I watch all your races.
Um...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If it's not any trouble, could I pick your
brain
some time? I have a lot of respect
for you...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
My brain?! BUT OF COURSE! My mind is
an open
book to you, my precious angel!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Who knew my new reputation would
allow me to
meet Umas I've barely had
the chance to interact
with before?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I think I can afford to
derail a
bit! Heck, I may as well lean into
it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I mean, isn't that part of being an
all-rounder in
the first place?! How
could I forget?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I can claim as many titles and meet as
many
Umamusume as I want!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's decided, Trainer! From here on out, I'm gonna be the Ruler of All !

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I like both, so why reject what's offered? I should keep this up and dominate all races of all distances!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital is far more than just a
versatile
runner. She's proven herself to
be one of the
fastest in history.
